response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced fullstack engineer (18+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js depth, direct AI agent and MCP tooling experience, a demonstrated testing/TDD culture, and cloud/container exposure (AWS CDK, Kubernetes, Docker). He exceeds the 6+ years requirement and covers most of the required stack. The main gaps are the absence of explicit Nest.js, Kotlin, and Vitest/Playwright experience, and his frontend history leans more toward Ember.js than React, so an interview should probe React and Nest.js depth.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js fullstack experience across multiple senior roles, well beyond the 6-year requirement
Hands-on AI agent development experience, including MCP code generators and agentic workflow frameworks
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling authorship, and experience with high-scale, low-latency systems
concerns: No explicit Nest.js experience listed, a core framework in the primary stack
Frontend history is heavily Ember.js; React exposure appears limited to one role
Kotlin and Python are not mentioned, and specific testing frameworks (Vitest/Jest/Playwright) are not named

key_factors.factor: Missing Nest.js and limited React/Kotlin evidence
